title: Serialize all ordinary purchase order draft mutations with existing status and receipt locks
description: Stage3 core purchase order workflow. Use existing authenticated live ERP permissions, no new grants or HTTP/test identity bypass. Preserve source audit and all original failure logs. Relevant units, guarded genuine SQL on exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and fresh GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database only; reject existing/wrong targets before access, never drop/reset/read production configuration. Safe Release build/full unit suite required. Build completion is not full stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Use existing DbContext transaction protocol for ordinary create/update whether linked or manual. Discover persisted and proposed sales ownership without retaining reverse purchase locks; acquire bounded necessary sales source locks in deterministic ascending order before the shared purchase order lock. Never choose safety solely from request null ownership. Under locks reread persisted header/details/status/source and live existing procurement scope; changed discovery pointers reject atomically. Preserve source cancellation and receipt approval lock compatibility, no nested transaction or lock inversion.

Pending edit only; submitted/approved/deleted/cancelled cannot be edited or revived after competing transitions. Header/detail replacement plus number reservation and assignments form one atomic save; constraint/provider failure rolls back complete original state and clears partial tracking. Existing explicit source reassignment remains authorized and validates live approved source; no silent lineage clear. Preserve existing authenticated user/menu/customer policy, fail closed missing identity, no additional grants or downstream inventory/finance edits.

Two independent genuine SQL connections test manual edit versus submit/delete/cancel, linked request clearing/rebinding versus original source cancellation, forced detail replacement failure, coherent complete detail set and retained original source audit. Verify controlled losers and valid ordinary lifecycle. Seed lawful fixture identities/masters for existing caller regressions without production bypass; safe Release/full unit suite.

implementation_evidence: PurchaseOrderController CreateUnlinkedAsync/UpdateUnlinkedAsync explicitly omit transactions and shared order locks; Update dispatch trusts requested OwningSalesOrderId=null even if persisted order is linked. ERP371 serializes submit/approve/delete/cancel and ERP346/347 source linkage but ordinary unlinked update can race status/cancel and replace details outside those locks. ERP418 supplier quote conversion protects different entries. Full history has no all-path ordinary purchase draft mutation task.
